Question 1

Consider the straight line with the vector equation r=[1−23]+t[43−1]

for t∈(−∞,∞). Find the Cartesian equation of this line.

a
 x−14=y+23=z−3−1
b
 x−41=y−3−2=z+13
c
 x4=y3=z−1
d
 x+41=y+3−2=z−13
e
 x+14=y−23=z+3−1

decision.explanation: The vector equation gives x=1+4t, y=-2+3t, and z=3-t. Solving each for t yields (x-1)/4=(y+2)/3=(z-3)/(-1), which is option a.

 {0,−2,−4,−6,−8,−10,−12,…}

 {−3,−5,−7,−9,−11,−13,−15,…}
